description:
Hae-na, who is single from birth and has no time to date, can’t bear the lonely nights and calls her friend Eun-su to borrow a dildo.

‘under… “I don’t have a dildo or anything like that.”
She accidentally calls her coworker Jaehyun, not her friend… !
